build_quantize_llm_w4a4_fp4: build a quantization pipeline for Qwen3-Next using llmcompressor with NVFP4 weight and activation quantization
create_quantization_recipe: create a QuantizationModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with NVFP4 scheme and ignore lm_head and gate layers
